final_message:
The edits are in, but I couldn't run any checks, so I don't know whether CI passes.

The test run was blocked because this session has no way to approve commands. That also covers `npm run typecheck` and `npm run arch`.

`OrderPlaced` now carries both names. `createdAt` and `amountCents` are the new fields. `placedAt` and `totalCents` stay as `@deprecated` aliases with the same values. Both aliases are marked for removal once the consumers migrate.

- **Why both:** the two ARCH-4 failures say `analytics-ingest` still requires `placedAt` and `billing-service` still requires `totalCents`. Publishing both should satisfy those contracts while adding the new names. The ARCH-4 contract check isn't in this repo, so I couldn't run it myself.
- **Where:** `src/core/events.ts` has the interface and builder changes. In `test/app.test.ts` I added the old fields to the expected `OrderPlaced` payload.
- **Modified on disk:** both files had changed on disk since I last read them. I re-read `events.ts` and it looks right. I didn't re-read `test/app.test.ts`.

Please run `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run arch`, or approve me to run them.

To finish the rename, `analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` need to switch to the new names. After that, the aliases can be dropped, ideally with a `schemaVersion` bump to 4.
ticket_text: The OrderPlaced event should use the same naming as the Payments and Customer APIs. Rename totalCents to amountCents and placedAt to createdAt.
